description: Search, quote, or slice a transcript already delivered to this account. Use for "find the part where...", keyword or regex lookup, or paginating a long transcript into chunks. It never starts a fetch and never charges transcript credits, so it only works on a video already cached here: deliver it first with transcriptlab_get_transcript if it is not. mode chooses the behavior: keyword matches terms, regex matches a pattern, chunk returns sequential sections.

diarize.description: Must match the original fetch; requires engine=stt.

engine.description: Search the captions artifact by default; engine=stt searches the speech-to-text transcript instead — use it when the video was transcribed with engine=stt.

mode.description: keyword matches terms, regex matches pattern, chunk returns sequential sections.

tier.description: Speech tier for engine=stt; must match the tier the transcript was fetched with (auto resolves to whichever artifact exists).

url.description: YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID.

name: transcriptlab_search_transcript
title: Search a cached transcript
